answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The juniper is the collateral at risk, the atlas the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the delta the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many atlas groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the juniper into smaller, individually useless stakes.
